metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel closed-incident Teams notification. Authorize Teams and configure permissions before enabling.
Name of the new Consumption Logic App. Use a unique name to avoid updating an existing workflow or connection.
Azure public-cloud region supporting Logic Apps, Sentinel connector, and Teams connector.
Full ARM resource ID of the existing Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace, not its Customer ID. The deployment reads its Customer ID.
Destination team GUID (groupId in the Teams channel link).
Destination standard-channel ID, for example 19:...@thread.tacv2. URL-decode the ID if copied from a link.
Windows time-zone ID, for example UTC or India Standard Time.
Display label matching displayTimeZone, for example UTC or IST. This label does not perform time conversion.
Keep Disabled until RBAC and Teams authorization are complete. Redeploying reapplies this state.

notes.purpose: Post a concise management-facing Microsoft Sentinel closed-incident summary, with investigation evidence available on demand.
notes.fieldSources: Title, severity, owner, classification, reason, classificationComment and incident URL come from the trigger snapshot. Current comments come from the comments API. ClosedTime and reported closure source come from one SecurityIncident query.
notes.workspace: The deployment resolves the Customer ID from the existing logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId resource. This must be the workspace that supplies the triggering incidents.
notes.history: Queries retained logs from incident creation, not a fixed seven-day window. Matches the triggering modification timestamp; missing or delayed history is explicitly reported, without polling or substituting an earlier closure. Query results contain raw datetimes; display formatting is done only in Prepare_card_data.
notes.comments: The API is paginated by the HTTP action. The card previews the three newest comments. A best-effort expression removes common paragraph, line-break, and formatting tags before Teams rendering.
notes.permissions: System-assigned identity: Microsoft Sentinel Reader and Log Analytics Reader at workspace scope. Teams uses a separately authorized delegated user connection. See README.md.
notes.cardMaintenance: The adaptive card is embedded in Build_adaptive_card.inputs. No separate adaptivecard.json file is required.
notes.validation: Test this definition in Azure after saving. Local validation does not execute KQL or the managed HTTP pagination engine.
notes.cardAudience: Management view shows outcome, classification, closure summary, owner, closure time, readable lifecycle duration, and key volume metrics. Technical identifiers, data-quality notes, and analyst comments are collapsed by default.
notes.dataQuality: No business impact, root cause, or remediation is invented. A short or generic classification comment is explicitly flagged as incomplete for management reporting.
notes.timeDisplay: Management timestamps use the configurable displayTimeZone and displayTimeZoneLabel parameters. UTC timestamps remain in the collapsed audit section.
notes.privacy: Hard-coded tenant name and tenant ID were removed from the card. Workspace, incident number, and the incident link provide sufficient routing context for the management notification.

body.query:
let triggerUpdate = datetime(@{triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['lastModifiedTimeUtc']});
let incidentHistory = materialize(SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(@{triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['createdTimeUtc']})
| where IncidentName =~ tostring(dynamic(@{string(createArray(triggerBody()?['object']?['name']))})[0])
| where LastModifiedTime <= triggerUpdate
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by LastModifiedTime);
let triggerSnapshot = incidentHistory
| where LastModifiedTime == triggerUpdate
| where Status == 'Closed' and isnotnull(ClosedTime);
let closureSources = incidentHistory
| where Status == 'Closed' and isnotnull(ClosedTime)
| summarize arg_min(LastModifiedTime, ModifiedBy) by ClosedTime
| project ClosedTime, FirstClosedUpdate = LastModifiedTime, ReportedClosedBy = ModifiedBy;
triggerSnapshot
| join kind=leftouter closureSources on ClosedTime
| project ClosedTime, ReportedClosedBy, DurationSeconds = datetime_diff('second', ClosedTime, CreatedTime), FirstClosedUpdate

inputs.title: @take(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['title'], 200)
inputs.reason: @if(empty(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason']), 'Not recorded', if(equals(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason'], 'SuspiciousActivity'), 'Suspicious activity', if(equals(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason'], 'SuspiciousButExpected'), 'Suspicious but expected', if(equals(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason'], 'IncorrectAlertLogic'), 'Incorrect alert logic', if(equals(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason'], 'InaccurateData'), 'Inaccurate data', if(equals(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason'], 'NotApplicable'), 'Not applicable', take(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationReason'], 100)))))))

Add outcome, impact, containment or remediation, and validation before treating this as a complete management record.', take(body('Parse_fetched_data')?['incident']?['properties']?['classificationComment'], 900))

Closure time, source, and duration are therefore shown as unavailable.', 'Closure values matched the triggering update in retained SecurityIncident history.')

items.text: Comments are fetched when this notification runs and are not an immutable closure snapshot. Common formatting tags are removed on a best-effort basis. Open the incident for complete evidence and history.
